_provenance: Written 2026-11-06 by the session for plan 4b and plan 8i (spec D8). Patterns are the builder's choice, to be tuned at the owner's review: no free registry of standard numbers exists, so the check is of form only.

standard_patterns.name: iso_iec
standard_patterns.provenance: ISO and IEC identifiers: organisation, 3 to 6 digits, optional part and year (ISO 9001:2015, ISO9001:2015, ISO 9001, IEC 60364-4-41)

standard_patterns.name: csa
standard_patterns.provenance: CSA identifiers: optional CAN/ prefix, optional letter, number, optional part and year (CSA C22.1-21, CAN/CSA-Z462)

standard_patterns.name: ieee_std
standard_patterns.provenance: IEEE standards only (IEEE Std 1584); a journal reference that merely says IEEE is not a standard

malformed.fr: Norme citée sous une forme incorrecte : vérifier l'organisme, le numéro et l'année.
malformed.en: Standard cited in an incorrect form: check the body, the number and the year.

unreachable.fr: Adresse introuvable ou hors service : vérifier le lien.
unreachable.en: Address not found or down: check the link.

blocked.fr: Adresse protégée, vérification impossible : confirmer à la main.
blocked.en: Address is protected and could not be checked: confirm by hand.

uncited.fr: Référence non citée dans le texte : ajouter l'appel ou la retirer.
uncited.en: Reference not cited in the text: add the citation or remove it.
